pr_title: ansible-galaxy - enforce string versions and fix installing prereleases from scm sources
pr_body:
##### SUMMARY

Fix unhandled tracebacks in the dep resolver by enforcing string versions when loading Requirements.

Fix installing prereleases from virtual dependencies without `--pre` by adding them as direct requests before resolving dependencies.

Fixes #79109
Fixes #79168
Fixes #78067

##### ISSUE TYPE
<!--- Pick one below and delete the rest -->
- Bugfix Pull Request

##### COMPONENT NAME
ansible-galaxy

review_comments: We shouldn't start scanning the disk `if force_deps` — all this is being discarded on the next line in 50% of cases.
How about a less invasive approach? https://github.com/ansible/ansible/pull/81694
Making assertions when an object holding invalid data is already initialized is an anti-pattern. This should be checked in or before init...
